description: Led the frontend team building a design-system-driven UI using Preact, TypeScript and Tailwind. Improved performance by 40% through code-splitting, islandification and accessible components. Mentored junior engineers and introduced automated visual regression tests.

Built server-side rendered dashboards and internal tools with Deno, Fresh and SQLite. Implemented secure API endpoints, CI pipelines and feature flags. Delivered analytics features that increased user retention.

Contributed components, docs and bug fixes to multiple frontend libraries. Focus areas: accessibility, bundler optimizations and testing utilities. Maintainer of a small utility library used by several projects.
Delivered responsive websites and PWAs for startups and agencies. Responsibilities included UX collaboration, frontend engineering, performance optimizations and deployment automation.
